plan(CC-0117): replace static ExternalSecrets

Add the planning document for migrating the three remaining static
ExternalSecrets (keystone-admin, mariadb-root-password,
k-orc-clouds-yaml) to operator-owned per-ControlPlane projection,
extending the CC-0116 pattern from PR #442. The plan scopes one
operator feature, one manifest relocation to a kind-only shim, and
one consumer removal, so ControlPlanes are no longer pinned to the
default Quick Start identity in namespace openstack.
